methods.name: Exact powered critical gauge and finite branch-ratio jet calculus
capabilities: construct exact rational powered potentials on critical SCCs
extract gauge-invariant critical-cell ratio histograms and integer layers
construct the full powered branch-ratio jet when critical K is irreducible
evaluate exact normalized moment matrices from finite ratio levels
construct exact p0/root-selector/p1 first-response states without floating spectrum
methods.core_law: In irreducible critical scope, every explicit branch has an exact powered ratio lambda in (0,1], lambda=1 exactly on critical dominant branches, and the full normalized moment matrix is the finite exponential jet sum_j lambda_j^s M_j with M_0=K.
methods.hard_boundary: Full-jet and first-response formulas are not promoted for reducible critical K. Ratio jets are positive-rational multiplicity carriers, not signed/amplitude semantics or labeled provenance, and this reference implementation is not a runtime-complexity claim.
